response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, polyglot engineer who already holds a Staff Software Engineer title and is currently building AI-agent infrastructure (MCP tooling, agentic workflows) — a near-perfect match for the role's AI-native mindset requirement. He also has strong distributed, high-throughput systems experience (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby) and deep TypeScript expertise. However, there is no evidence of Python anywhere in his skills or work history, which is an explicit must-have, and the resume lacks clear signals of stakeholder management, on-call/incident response, or formal agile ceremony experience, making it worth a conversation to validate these gaps before deciding.
strengths: Currently building AI-agent/MCP infrastructure at Staff level, directly matching the AI-native engineering mindset the role demands
Proven distributed, high-throughput systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec, low-latency async architectures)
Broad systems thinking across web, mobile, embedded, and infra domains, plus founder/ownership experience with an open-source platform
concerns: No visible Python experience despite it being an explicit must-have skill
No clear evidence of stakeholder management or product/leadership coordination in past roles
No explicit mention of on-call rotations, incident response, or formal scrum/agile ceremony ownership
